capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D star system with one orbit per top folder and a planet per note
Open and edit notes in a panel over the map
Search notes by title or mentions from the map
Highlight notes with unticked tasks and list notes with due dates
Play an automatic camera tour and a time-lapse of vault growth
extras: Desktop only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a 'Buy me a coffee' donation link and a detailed privacy section stating it makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian lacks an immersive spatial way to see, open and edit the whole vault at once; the built-in graph is a static link diagram, not a workspace.

relations.evidence: Pairs well with Rho Zero, a dark theme in the same sand and charcoal.

summary: 3D star-system view that renders the vault as orbiting planets per top folder, with in-map note editing, search, task glows and due-date lists.
